# OpenFile: all 572 tools

## PDF Tools

Merge, split, sign, protect and edit PDFs.

### [Merge PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/merge-pdf)
Combine multiple PDFs into one ordered document with drag-and-drop sorting.
Input: PDF. Output: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop two or more PDFs (add more at any time with “Add files”). 2. Drag the cards to set the order, or sort by name. 3. Optionally rotate a file or limit it to a page range. 4. Press Merge and download the combined PDF.

### [Split PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/split-pdf)
Split by ranges, every N pages, or extract each page into a ZIP.
Input: PDF. Output: PDF, ZIP.
Steps: 1. Drop a PDF. 2. Choose a mode: custom ranges, every N pages, or one file per page. 3. Review the preview of the resulting parts. 4. Split and download the parts (multiple files come as a ZIP).

### [Compress PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/compress-pdf)
Shrink PDF size with smart image downsampling and stream compression.
Input: PDF. Output: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your PDF onto the Compress PDF area, or click to choose it. 2. Wait a moment while page thumbnails render locally. 3. Choose the pages and options you need. Previews update as you go. 4. Press the main action button and download the finished PDF.

### [Organize PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/organize-pdf)
Visually reorder, rotate, duplicate and delete pages with thumbnails.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop a PDF to see every page as a thumbnail. 2. Drag thumbnails to reorder; rotate, duplicate or delete pages. 3. Insert pages from other PDFs if you need them. 4. Export the reorganized PDF.

### [Delete Pages](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/delete-pdf-pages)
Remove selected pages and download the trimmed document.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your PDF onto the Delete Pages area, or click to choose it. 2. Wait a moment while page thumbnails render locally. 3. Choose the pages and options you need. Previews update as you go. 4. Press the main action button and download the finished PDF.

### [Extract Pages](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/extract-pdf-pages)
Pull selected pages into a brand-new PDF.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your PDF onto the Extract Pages area, or click to choose it. 2. Wait a moment while page thumbnails render locally. 3. Choose the pages and options you need. Previews update as you go. 4. Press the main action button and download the finished PDF.

### [Rotate PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/rotate-pdf)
Rotate selected pages or the whole document.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your PDF onto the Rotate PDF area, or click to choose it. 2. Wait a moment while page thumbnails render locally. 3. Choose the pages and options you need. Previews update as you go. 4. Press the main action button and download the finished PDF.

### [Add Page Numbers](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-page-numbers)

Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your PDF onto the Add Page Numbers area, or click to choose it. 2. Wait a moment while page thumbnails render locally. 3. Choose the pages and options you need. Previews update as you go. 4. Press the main action button and download the finished PDF.

### [Watermark PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-watermark)

Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your PDF onto the Watermark PDF area, or click to choose it. 2. Wait a moment while page thumbnails render locally. 3. Choose the pages and options you need. Previews update as you go. 4. Press the main action button and download the finished PDF.

### [Header & Footer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-header-footer)

### [Sign PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/sign-pdf)
Draw, type or upload a signature and place it anywhere, plus dates and initials.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop the PDF you need to sign. 2. Create a signature: draw it, type it in a handwriting font, or upload an image. 3. Click the page to place it; drag and resize as needed. Add dates or initials too. 4. Apply and download the signed PDF.

### [Edit PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/edit-pdf)
Add text, shapes, highlights, images and freehand drawing to any page.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop a PDF. 2. Pick a tool from the toolbar: text, shapes, highlight, image or freehand. 3. Click on the page to add elements; drag to move and use handles to resize. 4. Save and download the edited PDF.

### [Protect PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/protect-pdf)
Encrypt a PDF with a password and set print/copy permissions.
Input: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop a PDF. 2. Enter an open password (and optionally an owner password). 3. Choose permissions such as printing or copying. 4. Encrypt and download.

## Convert

Move between PDF, Office, Markdown, HTML and images.

### [PDF to Image](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-to-image)
Export PDF pages as crisp PNG, JPG or WEBP at any DPI. Output: PNG, JPG, WEBP, ZIP.
Steps: 1. Drop a PDF. 2. Choose PNG, JPG or WEBP and a DPI (150 for screens, 300 for print). 3. Select which pages to export. 4. Download one image or all pages as a ZIP.

### [Image to PDF](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/image-to-pdf)
Combine JPG, PNG and WEBP into one PDF with page-size controls. Output: PDF.
Steps: 1. Drop your images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC). 2. Drag to reorder them. 3. Pick a page size, orientation and margins. 4. Create and download the PDF.

### [PDF to Text](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-to-text)
Extract text from every page, with layout-aware ordering.
Steps: 1. Open PDF to Text and add your source file (or paste content where offered). 2. Adjust page size, quality or layout options in the side panel. 3. Check the live preview. 4. Convert and download the result.

### [PDF to Word](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pdf-to-word)
Convert PDF text into an editable DOCX document. Output: DOCX.

Input: JPG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF. Output: STL.
Steps: 1. Drop a photo. 2. Set the width, thinnest and thickest points, frame and curve. 3. Check the 3D preview. 4. Download the STL and slice it.

### [STL Inspector & Repair](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/stl-inspector)
Check STL files before printing: size, volume, weight estimate, watertight and manifold checks, normal flipping and triangle reduction.
Input: STL, OBJ, PLY, 3MF, OFF, AMF, GLB. Output: STL.
Steps: 1. Drop an STL (or OBJ, PLY, 3MF). 2. Pick the file units and your filament. 3. Read the report and apply fixes if needed. 4. Download the fixed STL.

### [GLB / glTF Optimizer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/gltf-optimizer)
Shrink GLB and glTF files with Meshopt compression, quantisation, mesh simplification, deduplication and WebP texture resizing.
Input: GLB, GLTF, BIN, PNG, JPG. Output: GLB.
Steps: 1. Drop a GLB, or a glTF with its .bin and textures. 2. Pick the optimisations and the texture size and format. 3. Press Optimise and compare before and after in the viewer. 4. Download the optimised GLB.

### [G-code Viewer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/gcode-viewer)
See 3D printer, CNC and laser G-code layer by layer in 3D, with print time, filament and size.
Input: GCODE, NC, NGC, TAP. Output: PNG, CSV.
Steps: 1. Drop a G-code file. 2. Drag the layer slider to see the print build up. 3. Turn travel moves on or off. 4. Read the time, filament and size.

### [SVG & Image to 3D](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/extrude-to-3d)
Turn a logo, icon or drawing into a solid 3D model with set thickness, rounded edges and an optional base, for printing.
Input: SVG, PNG, JPG, WEBP. Output: STL, OBJ, GLB, PLY, USDZ.
Steps: 1. Drop an SVG or a picture. 2. Set width, thickness and rounded edge. 3. Add a base plate if you want one. 4. Download STL, OBJ or GLB.

### [3D Turntable Video](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/3d-turntable)

Input: GLB, GLTF, OBJ, STL, FBX, PLY, 3MF. Output: MP4, GIF, WebM, PNG.
Steps: 1. Drop a 3D model. 2. Set lighting and look in the viewer. 3. Pick size, length, camera height and background. 4. Press Make turntable and download.

### [Point Cloud Converter](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/point-cloud-converter)

Steps: 1. Drop a point cloud file. 2. Look around and pick how to colour it. 3. Thin it out if you want a smaller file. 4. Pick a format and download.

## Security & Privacy

Scrub metadata, lock files, hide messages, redact personal data.

### [Metadata Scrubber](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/metadata-scrubber)

### [Steganography](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/steganography)

Input: PNG, JPG, WEBP. Output: PNG.
Steps: 1. Drop a cover image. 2. Type the message or drop a small file. 3. Add a password if you like, then press Hide it. 4. Share the PNG. To read it, open the Reveal tab and drop the image.

### [Checksum Verifier](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/checksum-verifier)

Input: Any file, SHA256SUMS, MD5. Output: SHA256SUMS.
Steps: 1. Drop the files and their checksum list, or paste the expected hash. 2. Leave the algorithm on Auto. 3. Press Verify and read the match column. 4. Or press Calculate and save a new checksum file.

### [Password ZIP](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/zip-encrypt)

Input: Any file, ZIP. Output: ZIP.

### [PII Redactor](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/pii-redactor)

Steps: 1. Paste text or open a file. 2. Read the marked view and the table of findings. 3. Pick what to clean. 4. Copy or download the clean text.

### [Locked HTML File](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/self-decrypting-file)

Input: Any file. Output: CSV.
Steps: 1. Drop any file. 2. Hover the chart to read each block. 3. Check the byte histogram and byte types. 4. Download the block data as CSV.

### [Secret Note Link](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/secret-link)

### [Voice Anonymizer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/voice-anonymizer)
Change the pitch and tone of a voice in audio or video so the speaker is harder to recognise.
Input: MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4, MOV, WEBM. Output: M4A, MP4.
Steps: 1. Drop a recording or video. 2. Pick a preset or set the pitch. 3. Hear a 10 second preview. 4. Press Change voice and download.

### [Email Header Analyzer](https://aniruddhaadak80.github.io/OpenFile/email-header-analyzer)
Paste email headers to see SPF, DKIM and DMARC results, every server hop and delay, and phishing warning signs.
Input: Text, EML. Output: TXT.
Steps: 1. In your mail app, choose Show original or View source. 2. Copy the headers and paste them, or drop a .eml file. 3. Read the checks and warnings.
